question: In which year was the first population census conducted in India after independence?
solution:
The correct answer is, **'1951**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **total population recorded in 1951** was **361,088,090**.

 
 
• **No census was conducted for Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• The **most populated** region was** Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The **least populated** region was** Sikkim.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Census in India was conducted periodically from 1865-1941.
 
• The **Census of 1881** is also known as **the first proper census of India.**
